commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the secret warriors of the Xeech-Leel. The Hist trees are sickening because the Unbound (led by Cuts-the-Old-Knot) drain their sap and seal the scars with paralysis-poison paste. We want to find the Eye of Argonia first and use it at the Root to heal the trees. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is a relic-hunter who keeps getting ahead of me. 2. Go to the Grey Tooth Cave on the north face of the Grey Tooth on Skeith Isle and find what the Collectors men found there. 3. Fight the three hirelings at the foot of the goat-path, or slip past them. I can also examine Vanins Rubbing first. 4. I do not know what Vanins Rubbing shows. I can read it to find out. I also do not know what the Root gate needs or where the seven towers are.

answer 1. Same hunt for the Eye of Argonia for the Toh-Reel-Ka. The rubbing says the niche in the Grey Tooth Cave has been empty for twenty years: a captain ordered the stone carried to the ship Stormwidow. The Collector has sold her name to diggers. 2. Go to the wreck of the Stormwidow on the south-west beach of Skeith Isle and search her hold for the stone. 3. Fight or slip past whoever is digging at the wreck. The Collectors hirelings here are another matter I can skip. 4. I do not know what the stone is exactly (the kings stone) or what it opens. I may learn from the wreck or from what I find there.

answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka hunting the Eye of Argonia before the Unbound. I killed three Unbound scouts at the Stormwidow and took the Kings Marker Stone from the ballast crate. It shows seven towers in water, one cut deeper. I also have the seal recipe (grey caps and dried root ground to a numbing paste, signed C., so Cuts-the-Old-Knot) and three Unbound Seals. 2. Speak to the wounded scout Tah-Leesh on the sand below the bow of the Stormwidow. 3. Talk to her, or leave her, or kill her. She cannot stand and will not fight. 4. I do not know which of the seven towers is the deep-cut one, or where the towers stand, or what the stone is for. Tah-Leesh may know.

answer 1. Tah-Leesh, a wounded Unbound scout, said Cuts-the-Old-Knot tells whoever serves the Toh-Reel-Ka to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, the Archwardens fort on the Chixathe Mesa. She does not know what it means. It hints the order hides something, and my handler always knowing about the Unbound may be tied to it. 2. Bring the Kings Marker Stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom. 3. Go to Helstrom and hand it over, and ask her about the Fort Chalkmoth cellar. I could also go to Fort Chalkmoth myself, or ignore the hint as Unbound talk. 4. I do not know what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or why the leader says it to the order. I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or Nesh-Deeka, or go and see.

answer 1. I gave the Kings Marker Stone to Never-Writes-Twice. It shows the drowned spires off Lilmoth, seven towers on the sea floor of Benthic Yobesh, one marked deeper. She paid me 100 gold. She dismissed the Fort Chalkmoth hint, though I note she was quick to wave it away. 2. Go to Bell Station, a salvage station on an islet east of Lilmoth reached by boat from Lilmoth, where divers know which tower is marked. 3. Go to Bell Station first, or visit Fort Chalkmoth on the Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara to see what moans in the cellar. 4. I do not know what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar or why the Unbound leader says it. I can only find out by going there. I also do not know which tower is the marked one; the Bell Station divers should.

answer Notes: The Grey Tooth quest is done. At the Grey Tooth Cave a rubbing by the Collector (Vanin) said the stone went to the wreck of the Stormwidow. I killed three Unbound scouts there and took the Kings Marker Stone from the ballast crate. A wounded scout, Tah-Leesh, said Cuts-the-Old-Knot tells the Toh-Reel-Ka to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth (Chixathe Mesa, above Noota Nara). I handed the stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom and got 100 gold. The stone shows the seven drowned spires off Lilmoth in Benthic Yobesh, one cut deeper. The Bell Station divers, on an islet east of Lilmoth reached by boat from Lilmoth, should know which tower. I carry the seal recipe (grey caps and dried root ground to a numbing paste, signed C.) and three Unbound Seals. Next: Bell Station for the hunt, or Fort Chalkmoth first to learn what moans in its cellar. Never-Writes-Twice brushed that off too fast, so I suspect the order hides something. I have not checked the Collector hirelings at the Grey Tooth.
